data.name: lnkAutoUpgradeDB.ToolTip
data.value:
The database is currently configured not to upgrade automatically on service start. This will require you to deploy database changes manually each time you upgrade DBA Dash.
Click this link to enable automatic deployment of database changes

data.name: lnkAutomaticUpdates.ToolTip
data.value:
Configure the service to automatically check and install updates on a schedule.
Prerequisites:
* Permissions: Service account must be a local admin (or able to start/stop services and kill processes) and have write access to the application folder. * Network: Machine must have internet access to download updates.
⚠️ Warning: If an automatic update fails, monitoring will stop until the issue is resolved manually.

data.name: pictureBox2.ToolTip
data.value:
Click the Connect icon to the right and enter the details of the SQL instance you want to monitor Or: * Enter the connection string manually. * Enter multiple connection strings, 1 per line * Enter server name(s), 1 per line
Source can also be a folder or a S3 bucket to import data from remote DBA Dash agents

data.name: chkMonitorReadReplicas.ToolTip
data.value: Probe each Azure SQL Database for a read-only replica (ApplicationIntent=ReadOnly) and monitor it as a separate instance. Only Business Critical / Premium / Hyperscale databases with a readable secondary are added.

data.name: label10.Text
data.value:
Connections are required to each AzureDB to capture data for monitoring. Alternatively, add a connection to the master database and check the option to scan for AzureDBs on service start and/or check the option to scan for new Azure DBs every 'X' seconds.
You can also click "Scan Now" to persist any new connections to the config file.

data.name: txtWatchXESessions.ToolTip
data.value: Comma-separated list of existing extended event sessions that may be watched / viewed via the messaging feature (XESessionFilter syntax: * = all, -name = deny, deny wins). Blank disables watching. Governs watching independently of Manage XE and Ad-hoc XE.

data.name: txtAllowedCustomProcs.ToolTip
data.value: Comma-separated list of your own custom stored procedures to allow (execute on demand). Each procedure must be listed explicitly (schema.proc or proc) - wildcards and * (all) are NOT supported. Blank = None.

data.name: txtAllowScripts.ToolTip
data.value: Comma-separated list of community stored procedures to allow (execute on demand). Blank = None. * = All (grants access to the full curated list of supported community procedures, not arbitrary procedures).
